title: Sharing the Pies

readiness.math: fair shares of a whole: halves and quarters; division
readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: Two apple pies, made with the apples you picked! I've cut each one into four slices: quarters.

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: Let's share the slices fairly among the tables.

steps.speaker: tobias
steps.prompt: Share the slices so every table has the same.

older.prompt: Three pies, each cut into quarters: twelve slices. Share them so every table has the same.

feedback.all_good: Fair shares: {n} slices each! That's half a pie for every table.

outro.speaker: tobias
outro.text: Two quarters make a half. And sharing makes everything taste better!

journal_line: I shared the apple pie slices fairly among the tables.
